text:
This was nothing like the pleasant experience described in the reviews or the one I had hoped for.
I arrived 15 minutes early to fill out any necessary paperwork. However, I was seen 20 minutes after my scheduled appointment time. During the wait, a staff member told me the doctor would see me in five minutes. Ten minutes later, I asked again, and the answer was still — “in five minutes” :)
No one offered me tea or water during the wait, which is usually standard in other clinics, where receptionists are more attentive and make clients feel welcome.
The doctor came out and began the consultation right at the reception desk. It was extremely inconvenient to talk in front of other patients and staff, and the loud noise from the street made it hard to hear or be heard. There was absolutely no sense of privacy.
After that I was asked about payment, even though I had come just for a consultation. I can only hope they wouldn’t have pulled a syringe out from under the desk and started the procedure right there, haha.
Maybe the staff were just tired (even though I was only offered an evening slot), and this isn’t how things usually go.
In any case I don’t want to leave the lowest possible rating. I didn’t go through with the procedure, so I can’t fully judge it’s quality, but I’ve decided to look for another clinic. I just hope the staff and management take this feedback seriously and work on improving the service.
